name: Pizza Slice
instruction: Create a 3D model of a pizza slice with pepperoni and cheese.

Shape accuracy: The object in the images is a pizza slice.
The pizza slice has a triangular shape.
The crust is thicker at the outer edge and tapers towards the point.
Color representation: The crust is a golden brown color.
The cheese is a light yellow to golden color.
The pepperoni is a reddish color.
Size: The size set in the script is reasonable for the object.
Proportion: The cheese and pepperoni are proportionate to pizza slice.
Texture and surface detail: The crust has a rough texture to simulate baked bread.
The cheese appears melted and slightly glossy.
The pepperoni has a slightly oily surface.

Three-dimensional spatial awareness: The pizza slice is positioned at an angle to display its triangular shape.
The toppings are evenly distributed across the surface of the cheese.
Object distance and contact: The crust is clearly defined and does not overlap with the cheese.
The pepperoni slices are placed directly on the cheese without gaps.

Instruction execution accuracy: The model accurately represents a pizza slice with pepperoni and cheese.
All specified toppings are present and correctly depicted.
